title: data/automation: refusal wording a package cannot reach: a state_machine message has no from/to holes, two failing validation rules arrive joined by '; ', and a screen flow's successMessage cannot read run variables
body:
## Source

Measured by HotCRM on platform **18.2.0** while implementing hotcrm#2371 (UX card "say refusals in business words", from the #2320 browser pass). The implementer's report is [hotcrm#2371 comment 6487801082](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/issues/2371#issuecomment-6487801082), and the HotCRM side landed as hotcrm#2376.

| # | Observed on 18.2.0 | Suggestion |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | A `state_machine` validation rule's `message` takes no template holes, so it cannot name the move it refused ("from Presented to Draft"), although the refusal's constraint in the response carries both values. HotCRM's `quote_status_progression` now lists the whole path by label instead. | Fill `{{from}}` / `{{to}}` (as option labels) in a state-machine message. Related: #25933 (the console names the allowed next states). |
| 2 | When two validation rules fail on one save, the user gets one line with the messages joined by `; ` (`@objectstack/objectql` 18.2.0 `dist/index.mjs:7084`, `ValidationError`). HotCRM's forecast rules worked around this by making the two rules exclusive. | Keep each rule's message as its own entry, located on its field where the rule names one, and let the console list them. |
| 3 | A screen flow's `successMessage` renders `{{enrolledCount}}` raw: it cannot read the run's variables. An autolaunched flow invoked as an action can reach them through `result.output`. HotCRM's enrolment flow ends on a result screen instead. | Resolve run variables in a screen flow's `successMessage`, as for autolaunched flows. |
| 4 | A `try_catch` region guarding a loop with two exits fails flow registration, so the author has to add join nodes. | Accept a guarded region with more than one exit, or say in the registration refusal which exits to join. |

## Acceptance

Each row is either taken, as a card of its own where it needs one, or answered "will not do" with the reason.

<sub>Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` lane seat (session `session_01J8VVAnPkgK6CWrJa6t7Fk5`) from hotcrm#2371's report. Dedupe: searched objectstack issues for state-machine message placeholders, semicolon-joined validation messages, screen-flow successMessage variables and multi-exit try_catch regions. Related, closed: #25933, #24914, #9414, #4389. No open card.</sub>
